Metadata.title: Gate
Metadata.description: A companion app for people grieving the loss of a loved one

Layout.rotatePrompt: Please rotate your device to portrait to use the app

Auth.registerSubtitle: Registration is only available with a .ru email address
Auth.confirmationSent: We've sent a confirmation email to {email}. Follow the link in the email, then sign in.

validation.emailDomainNotAllowed: Registration is only available with a .ru email address
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

Consents.modalIntro: To use Gate, you need to accept two consents. Both are required.
Consents.error: Could not save your consent. Please try again.

training_data.title: Consent to use materials
training_data.body: I consent to the use of the texts and correspondence of a real person, which I upload, to train the RAG model of their persona in the Gate app.

not_a_replacement.title: Understanding the limitations
not_a_replacement.body: I understand that Gate does not replace a real person and is not a substitute for professional psychological help. If I struggle to cope with the loss, I will reach out to specialists or people close to me.

Chat.errorRetry: Couldn't get a response. Please try sending your message again.
Chat.emptyState: Write your first message to start the conversation.

Settings.supplementPersona: Add more details about the persona
Settings.deleteConfirmBody: All uploaded materials, the persona's memory, and the entire message history will be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

Feedback.success: Thank you! Your message has been sent.

Safety.crisisResponse:
I'm sorry you're going through such a hard time right now — and I'm glad you told me about it.

Please reach out for help right now — it matters, and you deserve support. Free 24/7 mental health helpline: {hotline}.

If there is immediate danger to life, please call emergency services or reach out to someone close who can be with you right now.

I'm a companion app, not a specialist, and I can't replace professional help in a situation like this.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: Looks like there's no internet connection right now. Check your connection and reload the page.

Landing.intro: We built this app hoping it could make it a little easier to carry the loss of someone close. Here you can continue the conversation with the person you miss — say the things that were left unsaid, remember how they spoke and who they were.
Landing.disclaimer: Please note: Gate does not replace a real person and is not a substitute for real human connection or professional psychological help. If you're struggling to cope with the loss, please reach out to specialists or people close to you.
